# Care Less — Maks Nedbailo

> Care Less builds custom AI assistants and automations for owner-led businesses (restaurants, salons, clinics, real estate, e-commerce) across Spain and the UK. The focus is removing the founder as the bottleneck: faster customer response, fewer dropped leads, and ops that run without the owner in every loop.

## Start here

- [Bottleneck Score](https://maksnedbailo.site/score) — free, 2-minute diagnostic that scores where a business is losing the most time and money to slow response and manual ops. No booking required.
- [AI Map](https://maksnedbailo.site/ai-map) — the next step after the score: a working session that turns the diagnosis into a ranked, ROI-ordered build plan.
- [Homepage](https://maksnedbailo.site) — overview of the offer, mechanism, proof, and guarantee.

## How engagements work

1. **Bottleneck Score** (free, 2 minutes) — identifies the single biggest leak.
2. **Bottleneck Map** — a scoped, ROI-ranked plan for what to fix first.
3. **First build** — Maks builds the highest-leverage automation himself, scoped from the Map.

Maks builds every project personally — capacity is capped at 5 slots per month.

## Guarantee

If the Map doesn't find at least €10,000/year in recoverable cost, the session is refunded and the business keeps the map.
